### 1 — Scene
A breakfast tray with toast, a muffin, an egg, avocado and greens, a little orange, a banana, butter portions, coffee, and water. Both plates appear to belong to this meal.

### 2 — Vessels
- **Toast plate:** approximately 20 cm diameter → **314 cm²**.
- **Egg/muffin plate:** approximately 20 cm diameter → **314 cm²**.
- Coffee cup approximately 7 cm across; water glass approximately 8 cm across.
- Banana and butter portions sit directly on the tray.

### 3 — Items
Two toast slices, a small muffin, one cooked egg, avocado slices, lettuce, orange pieces, banana, two butter portions, a likely light butter coating on the toast, black coffee, and water. No separate dressing is clearly visible.

### 4–6 — Area, volume, and weight
Areas are approximate top-down footprints. Overlapping components are not counted twice in plate coverage.

| Item | Vessel coverage / area | Area × average height = volume | Bulk density | Estimated weight |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Toast, two slices | 70% of toast plate = 220 cm² | 220 × 1.3 = 286 ml | 0.30 | 86 g |
| Muffin | 20% of second plate = 63 cm² | 63 × 3 = 189 ml | 0.35 | 66 g |
| Egg | 18% = 57 cm² | 57 × 0.85 = 48 ml | 0.95 | 46 g |
| Avocado | 14% = 44 cm² | 44 × 1 = 44 ml | 0.65 | 29 g |
| Lettuce, exposed portion | 10% = 31 cm² | 31 × 0.85 = 26 ml | 0.15 | 4 g |
| Orange pieces | 6% = 19 cm² | 19 × 1.05 = 20 ml | 0.60 | 12 g |
| Banana, edible portion | Approximately 72 cm² footprint | 72 × 2.2 = 158 ml | 0.65 | 103 g |
| Packaged butter, contents only | Approximately 24 cm² | 24 × 0.6 = 14 ml | 1.0 | 14 g |
| Likely butter on toast | Overlaps toast footprint | Thin coating ≈ 5 ml | 1.0 | 5 g |
| Coffee | Cup area ≈ 38 cm² | 38 × 4.2 = 160 ml | 1.0 | 160 g |
| Water | Glass area ≈ 50 cm² | 50 × 4 = 200 ml | 1.0 | 200 g |

**Coverage check:** toast covers about **70%** of its plate; food covers about **68%** of the second plate. Banana weight excludes the peel.

### 7 — Energy
Using kcal per 100 g: toast 265, muffin 360, egg 145, avocado 160, lettuce 15, orange 47, banana 89, butter 717, black coffee 2, and water 0.

This gives approximately **816 kcal**.

### 8 — Sanity check
Estimated edible food weight is **365 g**, or **725 g including beverages**. This is plausible for the visible breakfast: bread, muffin, and butter supply most of the energy, while the small garnish contributes very little. Muffin size and butter quantities are the largest uncertainties.
